title: Implement Alpaca bar fetcher with pagination and rate limiting
objective: An AlpacaFetcher class can retrieve historical bars from Alpaca API with proper pagination, rate limiting, and error handling

interface_contract.constructor: (self, config: AlpacaConfig, logger: BoundLogger | None = None)

methods.name: fetch_bars
methods.signature: (self, symbols: list[str], start: datetime, end: datetime, timeframe: Timeframe) -> pd.DataFrame

methods.name: _paginate
methods.signature: (self, symbol: str, start: datetime, end: datetime, timeframe: Timeframe) -> list[dict]
methods.returns: List of raw bar dicts from Alpaca

interface_contract.rate_limiting: Respects 200 requests/minute limit with exponential backoff

acceptance_criteria: fetch_bars returns wide-format DataFrame with {SYM}_{field} columns
Pagination handles next_page_token correctly (tested with mock)
Rate limiter sleeps when approaching limit (tested with mock)
All Alpaca HTTP calls go through a single _request method (mockable)
Timeframe enum maps correctly to Alpaca API timeframe strings
Empty response returns empty DataFrame with correct columns
Logger records fetch start, page count, total bars fetched
non_goals: Real API calls in unit tests
